items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: What you taking my time when we went out there and made seven dollars from eight to four... Peter here, Peter and Professor Minetta there... I just got a kick out of it, me. Otherwise, I was, I got a kick out of it just to be out there. Otherwise, tell you about the facts about it. Just so I was out

ctx.x: They had very few readers in them days, but they all played nothing but that jazz by head. Of course, Peter here, Peter and Professor Minetta there, well, they, they came up in schooling, you understand? They had a schooling for, for music. See, Pete played any kind of instrument. It's likewise with Minetta. See, Minetta never done anything in his life but that. Peter, too. Peter never, never knows what a hard-to-earth work was in his life. That's all he done for a living. What you taking my time when we went out…
Well, you like to listen to bands, too, huh?
